nodes.name: Ni mesh cleaning and sulfidation
nodes.procedure: Ni mesh substrate was ultrasonically cleaned in ethanol, diluted HCl, and then deionized water for 20 min prior to use. The purified NM was transferred into a 100 mL flask with 60 mL homogeneous solution including 1 M LiCl, 1 M H3PO4, and 1 M thiourea, respectively. The resulting solution was then heated to 120 °C in an oil bath for 2 h with a stirring rate of 320 rpm to fabricate the Ni3S2 on NM substrate. Until the flask was cooled down to R. T., the samples were taken out, rinsed several times with ultrapure water, and dried at 80 °C.

nodes.name: In situ NiFe(OH)x assembly on Ni3S2/Ni
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Ni3S2/Ni was transferred into a 100 mL flask containing a homogeneous solution of 1mL FeCl2 (0.4 mmol), 1mL Na3C6H5O7·2H2O (0.025 mmol), and 38 mL ultrapure water. The resulting solution was then heated to 90°C in an oil bath for 6 h with a slow stirring rate of 200 rpm. Until the flask was cooled down to R. T., the brown samples were taken out, rinsed several times with ultrapure water, and dried at 80°C, which was denoted as NiFe(OH)x/Ni3S2/Ni.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe(OH)x / Ni3S2 / Ni shows strong metallic Ni peaks and weak Ni3S2 peaks; NiFe(OH)x is amorphous. HCl treatment reveals intense Ni3S2 peaks after NiFe(OH)x removal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For NiFe(OH)_x / Ni_3S_2 / Ni , strong diffraction peaks assigned to metallic Ni and relatively weak ones to Ni_3S_2 are observed. This could be ascribed to the growth of amorphous NiFe(OH)_x nanosheets on the Ni_3S_2 / Ni substrate.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe(OH)x / Ni3S2 / Ni shows rippled porous NiFe(OH)x nanosheets (≈3.5 μm thick) on Ni3S2 layer; Ni3S2/Ni shows dense rough Ni3S2 particles on Ni mesh.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For NiFe(OH)_x / Ni_3S_2/ Ni, rippled and porous NiFe(OH)_x nanosheets with a thickness of ≈3.5 μm were observed on the top of the Ni_3S_2 layer (Figure 1d,g,j).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms morphological features of Ni3S2/Ni, NiFe(OH)x/Ni3S2/Ni, and NiFe(OH)x/Ni samples consistent with SEM observations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphologies of the as-prepared samples were then investigated with scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe:Ni ratio on surface of NiFe(OH)x / Ni3S2 / Ni is ≈1:16, similar to NiFe(OH)x / Ni.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) elemental analysis shows that the Fe:Ni ratio on the surface of NiFe(OH)_x / Ni_3S_2 / Ni is ≈1:16

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe(OH)x/Ni3S2/Ni: Ni 2p at 873.72/855.92 eV (Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺, +0.2 eV shift), Fe 2p at 706.58/711.01 eV & 714.22/724.53 eV (Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺, +0.3 eV shift vs NiFe(OH)x/Ni), S 2p at 161.97/163.33 eV (sulfide, -0.4 eV shift vs Ni3S2/Ni) & 168.59 eV (sulfate). Indicates strong electronic interactions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared with the Ni 2p (873.52 and 855.71 eV, Figure 2d) and Fe 2p (706.29 and 710.73 eV, Figure 2e) spectra of NiFe(OH)_x / Ni , the BEs of Ni 2p are positively shifted to 873.72 and 855.92 eV (≈0.2 eV) and those of Fe 2p to 706.58 and 711.01 eV (≈0.3 eV) respectively

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe(OH)x exhibits n-type semiconductor characteristics with flat band potential VFB of -0.06 V vs RHE.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Mott-Schottky (M-S) plots measured at various frequencies indicate that the NiFe(OH)_x exhibits the characteristics of n-type semiconductor with the flat band potential (VFB) of -0.06 V versus RHE

nodes.characterization_summary: Tauc plot derived from UV-Vis spectrum indicates band gap of NiFe(OH)x is 2.72 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Tauc plot derived from UV-Vis spectrum indicates that the band gap of NiFe(OH)_x is 2.72 eV

nodes.characterization_summary: Work function of NiFe(OH)x is ≈4.97 eV and Ni3S2 is 5.91 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The work function of NiFe(OH)_x is ≈4.97 eV with ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS) measurement, which is smaller than that of metallic Ni_3S_2 of 5.91 eV
